page_title: PAR 2-1 MON | Parma v Monza 28/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Federico La Penna is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+8' 2 - 1 Lautaro Valenti (Parma) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Valentin Mihaila. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 2:1.
90+8' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) prepares to take a corner kick.

90+7' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass. Emanuele Valeri (Parma) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
90+7' A free kick on the edge of the box for Parma. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
90+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pedro Pereira (Monza) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+5' Drissa Camara (Parma) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+5' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90+4' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Parma.
90+3' Simon Sohm (Parma) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' We are about to witness a substitution. Pontus Almqvist (Parma) is replacing Antoine Hainaut.
85' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Kevin Martins plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Pedro Pereira (Monza). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
84' Salvatore Bocchetti has decided to substitute Patrick Ciurria and he is replaced by Kevin Martins (Monza).
84' Samuele Birindelli will be replaced by Pedro Pereira (Monza).
83' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
79' Close! Simon Sohm (Parma) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
78' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
78' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) inside the box.
78' NO PENALTY! Referee Federico La Penna has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Parma players are incensed.
76' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Parma, he's going to review using VAR.
75' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is penalised for holding. Federico La Penna signals a set piece. It's a penalty for Parma!
74' It is time for a substitution. Stefano Sensi (Monza) is on for Warren Bondo.
73' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
72' Here is a change. Dennis Man is going off and Fabio Pecchia gives the last tactical orders to Adrian Benedyczak (Parma).
70' Andrea Carboni (Monza) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
68' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Hernani (Parma) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Drissa Camara.
64' The foul by Warren Bondo (Monza) was seen by Federico La Penna who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
63' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
58' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Milan Djuric (Monza) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
57' Salvatore Bocchetti makes a tactical change due to a red card. Milan Djuric (Monza) comes on in place of Daniel Maldini.
56' 1 - 0 Goal! Stefano Turati gets a hand on the penalty from Hernani (Parma), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
55' Hernani (Parma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
54' Pablo Mari (Monza) is awarded a second yellow by Federico La Penna and subsequently dismisses him with a red one.
54' It’s a PENALTY to Parma after the VAR review!
52' There's a break in play and referee Federico La Penna must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Parma using VAR. This could be interesting!
51' The game is interrupted now, Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
51' Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
50' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
49' Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) sends a long cross over to Antoine Hainaut, but Stefano Turati comes forward to gather the ball.
46' Fabio Pecchia has made a change at the break. Ange-Yoan Bonny has come on in place of Mandela Keita (Parma).
46' Half-time substitution. Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) is replaced by Emanuele Valeri.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Monza failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

45+1' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Zion Suzuki inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the top right corner, but was denied by a great save. Monza force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' The free kick into the penalty area from Valentin Mihaila (Parma) is cleared.
43' Referee Federico La Penna sees the trip by Warren Bondo (Monza) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Parma in a dangerous position.
41' Dennis Man (Parma) plays a one-two with Valentin Mihaila, but the move breaks down.
39' Dennis Man (Parma) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
38' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
34' The referee is firm and issues Pablo Mari (Monza) a deserved yellow card.
33' Dennis Man (Parma) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Mandela Keita picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
32' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
31' A pass from Andrea Carboni (Monza) is intercepted by Zion Suzuki and the move breaks down.
28' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
28' This is a yellow card! Armando Izzo (Monza) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
27' The total number of attempts is 2:7. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:2.
24' Armando Izzo (Monza) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
23' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) plays a lovely through ball to Daniel Maldini, but he can't beat Zion Suzuki and loses the ball.
21' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Patrick Ciurria (Monza).

21' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Zion Suzuki leaps like a salmon to deny him.
19' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Patrick Ciurria. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
19' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
18' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Monza win a corner.
17' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
14' Dennis Man (Parma) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
14' Dennis Man (Parma) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. The ball goes out of play. Parma are awarded a corner kick.
14' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Armando Izzo (Monza). Parma earn a free kick.

12' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.

10' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Stefano Turati was alert and the score remains the same.
9' Daniel Maldini (Monza) has a goal ruled out for offside!
8' The referee points to the corner flag and Monza will take a corner.
7' The resulting corner from Patrick Ciurria (Monza) is cleared by the defence.
5' The Monza players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
4' Wait! Referee Federico La Penna has indicated he is going to review the Monza goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if the ball went out of play in the build-up.
3' Goal! Patrick Ciurria (Monza) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 0:1.
2' Daniel Maldini (Monza) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
2' Daniel Maldini (Monza) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar.
1' Daniel Maldini (Monza) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
1' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Patrick Ciurria (Monza), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Monza will have the kick-off.
Federico La Penna is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
Show lineups
